title: Optimizing the Unique HSM Reference Rank-Group Index
summary: The reference rank-group index for unique HSM remains unoptimized; find better choices and quantify their complexity savings, though the overall effect is expected to be negligible.

formal_statement.body: Determine how to choose the reference rank-group index $r'$ in the unique half-space-mask (HSM) algorithm to improve its complexity, and quantify the reduction achieved by better choices. The existing choice of $r'$ was not optimized, and better options are likely to exist; because the unique HSM algorithm does not dominate the overall complexity, such improvements are expected to have negligible effect on the overall complexity.

scope.domain: Complexity optimization in structural cryptanalysis for the unique half-space-mask algorithm.
parameters: Reference rank-group index r′: identifies the rank group used as the reference and is the choice to optimize
scope.unresolved_remainder: Identify better choices of r′ and quantify the resulting reduction in the unique HSM algorithm's complexity.
